# East Bridge Solutions

> Advisory and execution firm working at the interface of China and Israel, supporting Chinese enterprises in market entry, partnerships, and transaction-related initiatives in Israel.

East Bridge Solutions operates on the ground in Tel Aviv, taking direct responsibility for execution — coordinating stakeholders, structuring interactions, and driving concrete business outcomes. The firm is led by its founder, Daniel Israeli. Support spans four models: Market Clarity (diagnostic strategic support for companies exploring Israel), Access & Introductions (targeted access to partners and decision-makers), Deal Support (execution from engagement through negotiation and structuring), and Local Representation (ongoing on-the-ground ownership and accountability).

## Case studies

- [Case studies index](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/): Seven representative China–Israel engagements spanning industrial manufacturing, medical technology, art & investment advisory, and automotive/EV technology.
- [Industrial & Manufacturing](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/industrial-manufacturing/): Local representation for a Chinese precision-components supplier pursuing the AI data centers market with a prominent Mag7 customer in Israel.
- [Medical Technology — Publicly-Traded Medical Group](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/publicly-traded-medical-group/): Confidential deal support for a $15M medical device acquisition.
- [Medical Technology — Medical Aesthetics](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/medical-aesthetics/): Independent due diligence for a strategic investment evaluation.
- [Art & Investment Advisory](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/art-investment-advisory/): Access and introductions to Israeli collectors, family offices, and investors for Arthouse Advisory.
- [Medical Technology — Dajing Medical](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/dajing-medical/): Market access support for an endoscopic camera systems manufacturer entering Israel from zero prior presence.
- [Technology & Components](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/technology-components/): Scoped market research for an industrial storage-solutions manufacturer.
- [Automotive & EV Technology](https://eastbridge.solutions/en/cases/automotive-ev-technology/): Program management for a top-3 global EV manufacturer's Israel-based model introduction.
